_about: "dates": the update each release date belongs to, from the TF2 Wiki's patch pages ({{Update info}} / update =): a date with a name was part of that update; "" is a patch the wiki doesn't put in a named update; a date that isn't here had no patch (a promo's or workshop item's own date). "items": the patch each item came in with (its wiki infobox's "released"), as {date: [defindexes]}.
